rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the substantial behaviour the plan needs (axis, X-point, wall contact and class off one signed-flux tree) is already behind the deep module `nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:384 build_contour_tree`; §1, §3 and §5 propose parallel shallow logic instead of deepening or extending it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 forks critical-point detection from the already-landed contour tree, and §5 forks qualification from `Topology.read_qualification`.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan proposes a new centroid-free saddle detector (§3) and a joint qualification layer (§5) without citing the prior-art search that already exists for exactly this capability, `docs/evidence/contour-tree-topology-authority/reuse-map.md`, whose row 8 names the two jax polishes being proposed again.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §5's joint qualification rule is a wrapper over per-row fields the census already publishes (`nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:1600 read_census`) and over `nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1125 read_qualification`, with no reason given why that reader cannot carry the joint verdict.
